subtopics.label: Psoriasis Treatment and Outcomes Across Diverse Skin Types
subtopics.description: Research on the efficacy and safety of biologic and topical therapies for psoriasis (including guselkumab, ixekizumab, risankizumab, secukinumab, and calcipotriene/betamethasone) with specific attention to outcomes in patients with skin of color and diverse racial/ethnic groups. Includes clinical trial analyses, health disparities, and geographic barriers to psoriasis care.

subtopics.label: Atopic Dermatitis Therapeutics and Diverse Populations
subtopics.description: Clinical research on systemic and topical treatments for atopic dermatitis including abrocitinib, baricitinib, dupilumab, lebrikizumab, and tapinarof, with emphasis on efficacy across racial groups, Fitzpatrick skin types, and special populations. Includes development of disease severity assessment tools for diverse skin types.

subtopics.label: Hidradenitis Suppurativa: Disease Characterization and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the pathophysiology, comorbidities, and treatment of hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), including biologic therapies (adalimumab, ertapenem), corticosteroid injections, antiandrogen therapy, and inflammatory biomarkers. Encompasses disease severity assessment, comorbid conditions such as PCOS, and treatment in special populations including intellectually disabled patients.

subtopics.label: Acne Vulgaris Treatment and Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation in Skin of Color
subtopics.description: Research on acne treatment strategies tailored to patients with skin of color, including topical agents (trifarotene, dapsone gel, clindamycin/adapalene/benzoyl peroxide), management algorithms, and treatment of acne sequelae such as post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. Addresses racial and ethnic variations in acne presentation and therapeutic response.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Immunotherapy and Checkpoint Inhibition
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on immune checkpoint inhibitors (nivolumab, ipilimumab, PD-1 blockade) and combination immunotherapy strategies for advanced melanoma, including long-term survival outcomes, adaptive dosing, and mechanisms of T cell-mediated antitumor immunity. Encompasses CAR T cell approaches and neutrophil engagement in antigen escape.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Targeted Therapy, Biology, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Research on BRAF/MEK-targeted therapies (dabrafenib, trametinib) for BRAF-mutant melanoma, melanocyte biology including melanin synthesis and melanosomal pH regulation, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte prognostication, and racial disparities in melanoma outcomes. Includes studies on acral melanoma staging and metabolic interventions.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma and Lymphoproliferative Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and histopathologic studies on primary cutaneous lymphoproliferative disorders including mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and CD4+ small/medium-sized T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder. Covers treatment approaches, pediatric presentations, disease classification, and outcomes in special populations.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Rare Skin Tumors, and Metastasis
subtopics.description: Research on cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) in immunocompromised patients, molecular mechanisms of SCC metastasis via the CD200-CD200R axis, and rare cutaneous neoplasms including Kaposi sarcoma, primary cutaneous leiomyosarcoma, and chondroid syringoma. Includes genomic characterization of skin tumors.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cutaneous Manifestations and Skin Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies on skin manifestations of COVID-19 including livedoid and purpuric eruptions, complement-mediated microvascular injury, SARS-CoV-2 protein deposition in cutaneous microvasculature, and skin biopsy findings correlating with disease severity. Includes COVID-19 vaccine-induced skin reactions and vulvar aphthous ulcers post-vaccination.

subtopics.label: Melasma, Pigmentation Disorders, and Cosmetic Dermatology
subtopics.description: Clinical research on treatment of melasma and pigmentation disorders including hydroquinone, novel depigmenting agents, and combination skincare regimens, as well as cosmetic dermatology procedures such as dermal micro-coring and platelet-rich plasma/fibrin for facial rejuvenation. Includes education and training in cosmetic dermatology.

subtopics.label: Wound Healing, Skin Reconstruction, and Surgical Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on wound healing strategies and reconstructive surgical techniques including alpha-gal nanoparticles for diabetic and irradiated wounds, keystone advancement flaps, dermal regeneration templates for scalp defects, prevascularized collagen scaffolds, and topical tacrolimus for flap survival. Encompasses both experimental and clinical approaches to cutaneous repair.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Skin Disease Immunology and Neuroimmune Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies on immune and neuroimmune pathways in inflammatory skin diseases, including IL-23/Th17 axis in psoriasis, Langerhans cell antigen presentation and CGRP-mediated Th17 immunity, lupus photosensitivity via ADAM17 dysregulation, axon-T cell feedback loops in skin inflammation, and kynurenamine immunomodulation.

subtopics.label: Infectious Skin Diseases and Dermatologic Manifestations of Infection
subtopics.description: Clinical and diagnostic research on infectious dermatologic conditions including monkeypox/mpox recognition and management, Kaposi sarcoma associated with KSHV, and skin manifestations of systemic infections. Covers diagnostic approaches, clinical guidance, and epidemiology of cutaneous infectious diseases.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Tools in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning and deep learning approaches to dermatologic diagnosis, including interpretable ensemble models for skin lesion classification, automated tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte scoring for melanoma prognostication, and computational image analysis for skin disease detection.
